topSignals.title: US markets closed for Labor Day — no Bloom/FCEL trading activity to report.
topSignals.text: Sept 7, 2026 is a federal holiday; NYSE and Nasdaq were closed. Bloom Energy's last print remains Friday Sept 4's close of $252.87 (+7.35%) with an after-hours run to $266.14 on confirmed S&P 500 inclusion (effective Sept 21); FuelCell Energy's last print remains Friday's $14.72. No new market data expected until Tuesday Sept 8.

topSignals.title: Elcogen: confirmed quiet for a ninth straight day.
topSignals.text: Direct newsroom check (elcogen.com/category/news, re-verified today) shows nothing posted since the Aug 31 write-up of the Aug 24 Paris MoU with China Southern Power Grid group company Guangzhou Xinzhili Energy Technology. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (>75% FC electrical efficiency, 90% with heat recovery, 650°C) in volume production at ELCO I Tallinn (360 MW/yr). Elcogen News

topSignals.title: Topsoe: SOFC/SOEC side still quiet.
topSignals.text: No press-room item beyond the already-logged Aug 27 H1 2026 results, the Aug 28 full-year guidance revision (revenue raised to DKK 8,000–8,500m, EBIT margin raised to 7.0–10.0%, driven by Technology/catalyst-sales strength — not SOFC/SOEC), and the March 2026 SOEC pathway reset (Herning hibernation). No SOFC-specific announcement identified today.

items.text: Elcogen (priority): See Top Signal #2. No other announcements found.
Topsoe (priority): See Top Signal #3. No SOFC/SOEC-specific announcement identified.
No new stack/cell announcements found from Bloom, Ceres, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin, or Convion.
Virginia data-center electricity tax ($0.011/kWh, applies to self-generated power too): unchanged, first monthly returns due this month.
FERC RM26-4 large-load interconnection: unchanged; RTO/ISO show-cause responses due Nov 16, 2026.

Spain's draft decree on data-center renewable-energy requirements (EU-establishment, in-EU data residency, provisional energy/water efficiency limits) had its public-hearing window open through Sept 4 — final terms could still shift; worth a follow-up check once finalized, since it would be the first EU country-level data-center energy rule with this scope.

Australia (AEMC): regulators continue pushing for large data centers to bring their own firmed clean generation and pay full network-connection costs, following PM Albanese's July 15 "net-generators, not net-users" pledge — still a proposal, not yet legislated; relevant as a potential precedent for BTM-SOFC-favorable rules outside the US/EU.
Rolls-Royce SMR UK GDA, Germany EnEfG, Texas ERCOT audit, US ITC 45V/48E: unchanged.
